scope: First research pass for narrative style and independent-continuity design; not an exhaustive game-playthrough or anime-viewing audit.
latest_user_decision: Begin with young Ash in Pallet Town and preserve recognizable classic storylines; advance multiple years across later story cycles into adulthood; government and consequential political struggle must be explicit. The youth-assistant and relief-truck opening are retired.
